game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: In Crystal Grotto, repeat each round: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word. Each round, rock golems strike the wooden door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the queue_length value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wooden door from rock golems in Crystal Grotto: keep the queue_length meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: queue_length drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Sentinel Loop
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Sentinel Loop' (Week 4 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Crystal Grotto'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_length changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Crystal Grotto.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while queue_length > 0.
